args.title: Juniper Labware newsletter — Freight pricing this quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest issue covers freight pricing this quarter (https://blog.juniper.example/2026/freight).
- Linked article: Spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (subscriber access via team code SUB-7378): Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
